designationHistory.indexText: Us Visit Us Activities Trails Get Involved Events News Library Species Map https://www.facebook.com/NoxubeeNWR About Us Established in 1940, Noxubee National Wildlife Refuge is located in three counties (Noxubee, Oktibbeha, and Winston), and was created from lands obtained through the 1930s Resettlement Administration.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
